nodes.title: Route Configuration's text to the test panel's hook
nodes.summary: ConnectorTestPanel gains a required configurationText prop that ConnectorConfigurationDetailReadyView fills with its own live state.configuration.value and forwards into useTestConnectorPanel(connector, configurationText).

nodes.title: Proof for routing Configuration text into the test panel's hook
nodes.summary: Three new spec files prove configurationText reaches useTestConnectorPanel through both production call sites, by reading what each seam actually received back off the DOM rather than recording a call.
